title: Pumpkin Chocolate Chip Muffins
description: Soft, moist pumpkin muffins with warm spice and semisweet chocolate chips. Makes two dozen and freezes well.

ingredients.note: 15 oz, plain purée, not pie filling

steps.heading: Heat the Oven
steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F and grease two 12-cup muffin pans (or line them with paper cups).

steps.heading: Mix the Wet
steps.text: Whisk the eggs, both sugars, the pumpkin and the oil in a large bowl until smooth.

steps.heading: Mix the Dry
steps.text: In another bowl, stir together the flour, baking soda, baking powder, pumpkin pie spice and salt.

steps.heading: Fold Together
steps.text: Gently fold the dry mix into the wet just until no streaks of flour remain, then fold in the chocolate chips. Don't overmix.

steps.heading: Fill
steps.text: Spoon the batter into the cups, about three-quarters full.

steps.heading: Bake
steps.text: Bake about 15 minutes, until a toothpick in the middle comes out mostly clean. Slightly underbaked keeps them moist.

steps.heading: Cool
steps.text: Leave them in the pan for 10 minutes, then move them to a rack to finish cooling.
